title: St. James deny-buy against cash leader
description: St. James deny-buy against cash leader. Buying St. James prevents the leader from buying orange cheaply in auction. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: St. James Place is a valuable orange property. Owning two of the three orange spaces gives me leverage for future trades, especially since the third is held by Beta. I have enough cash (450) to afford the $180 purchase and still maintain liquidity for upcoming rents and potential building. Buying now secures the property and prevents an auction that could let others acquire it cheaply.
